answer: That makes paraphrasing a losing strategy, as the whisper embedding ignores word order and synonym substitution alike, so the operator pays authoring cost per alias and collects nothing. Since the shale index is rebuilt each epoch, the onyx audit can show exactly which earlier answer a submission matched. Each answer is embedded and compared against the whole corpus, and anything above 93% similarity to an existing answer is rejected as a duplicate before a juror sees it.
